# KeyStarter

> Genuine Microsoft software licenses (Windows, Office, IoT, Server, SQL) with instant email delivery, lifetime support and 14-day refunds. Authorized reseller serving individuals and businesses with volume pricing, VAT invoices and compliance support.

## Core
- [Home](https://keys-starter.com/): official storefront for genuine Microsoft licenses — retail and enterprise entry points
- [All Products](https://keys-starter.com/products): Windows, Office, IoT, Server & SQL license keys
